text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Overdosage of paricalcitol may lead to hypercalcemia, hypercalciuria, and hyperphosphatemia. [see Warnings and Precautions (5.1) ] . The treatment of acute overdosage should consist of supportive measures and discontinuation of drug administration. Serum calcium levels should be measured until normal. Paricalcitol is not significantly removed by dialysis.
